text:
payments-bot: Payment failed for INV-4999 (decline code: insufficient_funds). Attempt 1.

lina_finance: Noted — this is Summit Labs, annual invoice. I reached out to the billing contact earlier, no response.

kevin_support: Customer just replied in the ticket: they prefer ACH instead of retrying card. Asking for ACH instructions and whether we can mark invoice as paid once ACH is initiated.

lina_finance: We can accept ACH but we need confirmation of the ACH initiation + bank receipt to reconcile. Don't mark as paid until funds settle. Hold automated dunning and auto-cancel for 72h. @olga_accounting can you pause dunning?

olga_accounting: Pausing dunning for 72h and marking invoice status = "pending - ACH". When they paste the bank confirmation (routing + trace id) I will reconcile.

nate_sales: AM says customer will initiate ACH today if we send details. They're sensitive about routing numbers so please provide templated instructions (mask acct number).

lina_finance: ACH template below — use exactly this text. Ask them to include INV-4999 in the payment memo.

```
Bank: Example National Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: ****4321
Routing (ACH/ABA): 222000111
Account type: Checking
Reference / Memo: INV-4999
Please include company name and invoice number in memo.
```

kevin_support: Sent to customer at 11:02 PT with note: "Reply with bank confirmation (ACH trace/routing + approximate settlement date) and we'll reconcile immediately." Included link to invoice PDF: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-4999

lina_finance: Scheduled a single card retry in 48h in case they still want to update payment method. If ACH confirmation arrives before retry time, I'll cancel it.

payments-bot: Card retry scheduled for 1745595222 (48h).

olga_accounting: When ACH posts, paste the bank's confirmation + amount here. I'll apply payment and close invoice. If partial payment arrives, we'll hold until full amount unless AM approves partial.

nate_sales: AM to follow up with customer and cc accounting on the wire/ACH confirmation email.

kevin_support: keeping thread open until reconciliation. If no ACH by EOD +3, we'll escalate to collections. :warning:
